_about: The 3D match view (Stage 5, docs/STAGE_5_MATCH_DAY.md). Read by src/render/match. Distances in metres, speeds in metres per second, angles in degrees. Stadium space: x along the pitch (0 is the centre spot), z across it (+z is the main stand, where the broadcast camera sits), y up.

camera._about: The broadcast camera sits on a gantry just in front of the main stand (its front wall is at z 40) and pans to follow the ball. hfov is the horizontal field of view it keeps on any screen shape (the vertical one is clamped to minVfov-maxVfov). follow is the share of the ball's x the camera body moves; the aim follows the ball fully, out to maxX. lookZ is the share of the ball's z the aim takes. damping is how quickly it catches up (higher is snappier).

cameras._about: Stage 5.3: the other cameras. Each keeps hfov degrees of view across the screen (the vertical view clamped to minVfov-maxVfov), with near the closest it draws and damping how quickly it catches the ball. box: the owner's seat in the main stand's box row (eye above the box floor, behindGlass back from the glass), turning to follow the ball (turn and lookZ are shares of the ball's x and z). goal: high behind the goal, back from the goal line, height up; it swaps ends once the ball is swapAt into the other half, slides followZ of the ball's z and always looks at least minAhead in front of its own goal line. overhead: high over the pitch for watching the shape, following follow of the ball's x. side: a low camera on the near touchline that only the replays use; it zooms to keep about span metres of the play across the screen (never narrower than minHfov degrees, never wider than hfov), so play on the far side is not tiny, and slides back along the touchline towards halfway to stay at least minDist from play near it.

players._about: Gaits blend by ground speed. clips are each gait's own speed in the animation; the legs are sped up or slowed to match the ground, within timeScale. Below standAt a player stands; he faces his run when faster than faceRunAt, otherwise the ball. turnRate is how quickly he turns (per second).

kit._about: Kits are painted onto the bare base body by region, measured on the model's rest pose (a T-pose, about 1.8 m tall). y is height, ax the distance out along the arms.

looks._about: Each player's skin tone, hair colour and hair, seeded from his id. Styles list the hair pieces worn together; an empty list is a shaved head.

shadow._about: Soft round shadows under the players and the ball (cheaper than real shadows for 23 moving things).

overlay._about: Stage 5.4: the tactics overlay painted on the grass. It is drawn in colour (the game's gold, so it never reads as a pitch marking or a kit). Each line of the formation is a ribbon width wide over a dark edge edge wide (so it reads on any grass), the back line also runs the width of the pitch, backWidth wide, and a dashed line dash long with gap between marks where the line is aiming. The lines are the shape the team defends in: the spots in order of their depth without the ball (0 is the back line, 1 the front of the block), with a new line wherever the next spot is more than rowGap deeper. A tap picks the player drawn within pickPx (CSS pixels) of it; the ring under him is ring metres across. The player card refreshes every cardMs.

actions._about: Stage 5.2: what the players do with the ball. The 3D view runs lagMs behind the engine so a leg can swing back before the ball leaves it. A touch with the ball headerFrom or higher is a header, chestFrom or higher a chest. A tackle from slideFrom or further from the ball is a slide. A keeper with the ball in his hands throws it when it leaves slower than keeperThrowBelow and flatter than loftedVz (upward speed), otherwise punts it. fullPower is the ball speed of a full-power strike. A dive starts no sooner than keeperReactMs after the shot is hit; a shot that beats him still gets a dive if no higher than diveHighest. diveMatchMs pairs a catch or parry with the dive planned for it. Times in ms.
actions._moves: How the moves play out on the 3D players. kickWind is the backswing time of a soft kick in seconds (a full-power one takes kickWindPower longer). leftFooted is the share of players who kick with the left. A header jumps when the ball is jumpFrom or higher. A keeper dives when the ball is diveFrom or more to his side, no earlier than diveLead seconds before it arrives; diveReach is feet to fingertips. A keeper gets set (crouchSet of the crouch) when the other side has the ball within setWithin of his goal and he is slower than setBelow. Team-mates celebrate a goal within celebrateWithin of it. A thrown ball starts throwLift above where the engine has it, easing down over throwLiftMs.

replays._about: Stage 5.3: automatic replays in 3D. keepS is how much of the match the tape keeps (seconds). A goal is replayed goalAfter seconds after it goes in (as shown), a big chance chanceAfter seconds after the shot: a shot that does not go in with an xG of bigChanceXg or more, or hits the woodwork, or a great save: a shot of greatSaveXg or more that the keeper reached only by going greatReach metres or more, or faster than greatSpeed metres per second over the ball's flight. Each take plays from fromS to toS seconds around the moment at rate times real speed, on a camera (side or goal, at the end the shot went to). The live match waits while a replay plays. If the screen stops being drawn (the match is paused), a waiting replay starts after idleMs.
replays._highlights: Highlights mode: the 2D pitch plays, and each big moment is played in 3D from the tape, as a TV highlights show does: from leadS seconds before it to afterS after, at real speed, on the owner's camera. A moment is a goal, or a shot that is saved or hits the woodwork, or any shot with an xG of shotXg or more (as above, after chanceAfter seconds). A goal then gets its last goalTakes slow-motion takes from the goal list, and a big chance its chance takes.
